parts.title: The Silence on the Desolate Rooftop — Part 1

series.summary: Following Hisashi's tragic death on the school rooftop, Rei collapses in overwhelming grief beside his corpse. Takashi refuses to let her give up, forcing her to choose between surrendering to death or fighting for survival. Choosing to live, Rei attempts to contact her father, a senior police detective, for rescue. But with telecommunication networks completely severed and no emergency sirens sounding across the city, the two students realize civilization is paralyzed and they are entirely on their own.

segments.voiceover_text: On the rooftop, Rei is shattered by Hisashi's death. She stares at the bloodstained bat, praying that this living nightmare is just a cruel dream.
Takashi grabs her shoulders, forcing her to confront reality. He demands to know whether she wants to lie down and die right here.
Rei wipes away her tears. Looking Takashi directly in the eye, she resolves that she refuses to die today.
Rei frantically dials her father, a senior police officer. But every cellular network is dead, and the silence below proves no help is coming.

parts.title: The Classroom Barricade Begins to Fracture — Part 2

series.summary: Inside the locked school building, genius student Saya Takagi and bullied outcast Kohta Hirano take refuge inside a classroom. When Kohta clings to hope that the police or Self-Defense Forces will arrive, Saya bluntly crushes his optimism. She calculates that across Japan's population of 130 million, emergency responders will quickly be overwhelmed and infected themselves. Their grim debate is shattered by horrifying screams in the corridor outside, where students and teachers are dragged down and slaughtered against the frosted classroom windows. As bloody handprints smear the glass and the infected pound violently against their barricade, Saya and Kohta realize they must fight or be devoured.

segments.voiceover_text: Down inside the school, genius student Saya Takagi and gun enthusiast Kohta Hirano take refuge in a classroom. Kohta naively expects the police to save them.
Saya snaps that with Japan's population of one hundred thirty million, the police and army are powerless against an infectious collapse that turns responders into monsters.
Terrified screams suddenly erupt in the hallway. A fleeing student pounds frantically on the glass door before being dragged down into the darkness.
Blood splatters violently across the frosted window as the infected swarm. Shadows lunge against the barricade, clawing desperately to get inside.

parts.title: A Warrior's Honor and the Otaku's Wrath — Part 3

series.summary: Across the high school, two different battles for survival unfold. In the school infirmary, national kendo champion Saeko Busujima rescues school nurse Shizuka Marukawa. A first-year student named Ishii, bitten while shielding the nurse from infected staff, recognizes that his infection is fatal. Refusing to become a mindless monster, he begs Saeko to end his life with dignity, and Saeko delivers an honorable, merciful strike with her wooden bokken. Meanwhile, in the classroom, the infected breach the door and threaten to devour Saya. Bullying victim Kohta Hirano reveals an encyclopedic knowledge of firearms, rapidly modifying an industrial pneumatic nail gun into a deadly weapon. With icy precision and a manic grin, Kohta drives heavy steel nails directly through the undead attackers' skulls, obliterating the horde and proving himself a lethal survivor.

segments.voiceover_text: In the infirmary, national kendo champion Saeko Busujima stands guard over Nurse Shizuka. A wounded student named Ishii collapses on the floor, heavily bitten.
Ishii begs Saeko to strike him down with dignity before the virus turns him into a monster. Honoring his courage, Saeko delivers a merciful blow.
Meanwhile, zombies breach the classroom doors. Kohta modifies an industrial gas nail gun, stripping off the safety mechanism to transform it into a rapid-fire weapon.
As the undead charge inside, Kohta snaps into lethal focus. Grinning wildly, he drives steel nails straight through their foreheads, slaughtering the entire horde.

parts.title: Descent from the Sanctuary into the Shadows — Part 4

series.summary: Exhausted and covered in gore on the school rooftop, Takashi turns on a high-pressure water valve. The cool spray washes away the dried blood of their fallen friends, providing Takashi and Rei a fleeting sanctuary of sanity and relief. But staring out across the skyline, black smoke and distant explosions reveal that help is never coming. Remaining on the rooftop ensures eventual starvation. Refusing to die waiting, Takashi and Rei make a pact to break through the infested school and search for their families. Armed with a metal baseball bat and a reinforced spear fashioned from a broom handle, the two teenagers push open the heavy fire door and descend into the bloodstained stairwells below.

segments.voiceover_text: Up on the rooftop, Takashi cranks open a water valve. Cold water washes the gore from Rei's face and hands, granting them a brief moment of quiet relief.
Looking out over rising smoke columns, they realize staying on the roof means slowly starving. Both resolve to fight through the apocalypse to locate their families.
Takashi tightens his grip on his baseball bat, while Rei sharpens a broomstick into a spear. They prepare their bodies and minds for close combat.
Opening the reinforced door, Takashi and Rei descend into the darkness of the school stairwell, unaware that corridors below are already teeming with the dead.

parts.title: Uniting Blades and Blood in the Hallway — Part 5

series.summary: As Saeko and Nurse Shizuka advance through the lower corridors toward the faculty room, Saeko cautions that the reanimated dead possess overwhelming physical strength. Suddenly, the separate survivor groups collide in the central corridor, only to be encircled by an aggressive horde of zombies surging from both flanks. Forced into an immediate fight for their lives, the students coordinate instinctively: Saeko delivers bone-shattering strikes with her wooden sword, Takashi crushes oncoming attackers with his bat, Rei impales infected with her spear, and Kohta snipes flanking walkers with his nail gun. After slaughtering the swarm and securing the corridor, the six survivors catch their breath and introduce themselves. Overcome by the horror, Rei breaks down weeping for her mother, and the group rallies together in shared determination to reach the teachers' lounge and escape.

segments.voiceover_text: In the lower hallway, Saeko warns Nurse Shizuka that the infected possess monstrous physical strength. If the dead grab hold of you, escape is impossible.
Suddenly, all three survivor groups collide as an immense horde closes in from both flanks. Saeko shatters skulls with her bokken while Takashi bludgeons advancing attackers.
Rei drives her makeshift spear through an infected's skull while Kohta snipes charging walkers. Together, the six students completely eradicate the mob, securing the central corridor.
Catching their breath, Rei suddenly breaks down in tears, crying out for her mother. The survivors embrace her, realizing their survival depends on staying together.

parts.title: The Final Broadcast of a Collapsing World — Part 6

series.summary: Barricading themselves inside the faculty staff room, the six survivors catch their breath and search the room for a means of escape. Nurse Shizuka locates the keys to the high school minibus parked in the school lot, and the group agrees on a coordinated escape plan: fight their way to the vehicle and rescue their families in order of geographic proximity. But when Takashi turns on the television, a horrifying emergency news report shatters any hope of outside rescue. The broadcast confirms over 10,000 casualties in Saitama, declaring nationwide martial law as screaming infected overrun police barricades and breach the television studio live on air, slaughtering the anchors before static engulfs the screen. Facing the chilling truth that society has permanently collapsed, the students lock hands, steel their resolve, and prepare for their desperate breakout into the new world.

segments.voiceover_text: Inside the faculty lounge, the six students barricade the heavy door. Catching their breath, they urgently search the desks for vehicle keys to escape campus.
Nurse Shizuka locates the keys to the school minibus. The group maps out a route, agreeing to check on each member's family in order of proximity.
Takashi switches on the television. An emergency broadcast reports over ten thousand casualties in Saitama alone, revealing that police and government authority have utterly collapsed.
On live television, zombies swarm the news desk and butcher the anchors before the broadcast cuts. Knowing civilization is gone, the survivors resolve to fight their way to the bus.
